mechanism: Applies {{shard}} across orthogonal dimensions (e.g., Spatial, Temporal, Semantic). Agents subscribe only to dimensions relevant to their function ('Slices'). It enables massive {{parallelize}} by decoupling {{state}} into orthogonal dimensions.
failure_modes: Cross-thread coordination latency grows with the number of dimensions a read spans.
False orthogonality: two dimensions correlate, so partitioning by both buys no parallelism.
invariants: The dimensions sharded across are orthogonal: a key in one does not determine a key in another.
An agent subscribes only to the dimensions its function needs.
Each dimension's domain is orderable or partitionable.
